newsitem.title: USA: Digene sees Q3 launch of Microplate Assays.
newsitem.headline: Digene sees Q3 launch of Microplate Assays.

text.p: Digene Corp said on Thursday it expect the first international commercial launch of new microplate assays developed for HIV RNA, chlamydia and gonorrhea during its fiscal third quarter, beginning in January.
"The new microplate tests being developed are expected to represent significant advances in sensitivity, reliability and ease of use compared to current diagnostic practice," the company said.
"We expect the first commercial launch of these new microplate assays to occur internationally during the third quarter of fiscal 1997."
Digene develops, manufactures and markets DNA testing systems for screening, monitoring and diagnosis of human diseases.
